title: ОписаниеСитуации (Речь)
description: Объясни, почему ситуация сложилась таким образом. Пример: I was hungry because I hadn't eaten breakfast. / The ground was wet because it had rained.

conditions.label: Past Perfect — причина (had + V3): что случилось раньше
conditions.hint: I was hungry because I hadn't eaten breakfast. / The ground was wet because it had rained.

conditions.hint: I was hungry. / The ground was wet.
